name: design-polish
description: Design reference-based polishing with WCAG accessibility checks. Measurement engine (real styleFit/performance), mobile a11y + touch targets, close-the-loop verification (renewal auto-captures pre-apply baseline), route auto-discovery. v2.5.0: design contract (DESIGN.md + design-decisions.json) with ratcheted token-drift lint, Korean typography rules, component state contract, numbered rule IDs. v2.6.0: keyboard-measured focus audit, contract-hashed token baseline, split penalty caps, 4-level severity, script-computed stagnation/severity rollup, shared fail-closed backup procedure, Unicode-aware BM25 search.
